newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain H1 oil product deliveries down 1.7 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Spain H1 oil product deliveries down 1.7 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Spanish oil product deliveries in the six months to end-June fell 1.7 percent year-on-year to 17.4 million tonnes, according to provisional figures from Spain's association of product traders AOP on Thursday.
Contributing to this slump was a 2.5 percent decline in petrol sales, a 0.9 percent fall in gas oil and a 4.9 percent fall in fuel oil in the first half.
The decline was explained by switching to diesel, as well as less consumption and mileage by new vehicles, AOP said. Bad weather in June alone also impacted petrol consumption.
Total gas oil sales in June rose 2.7 percent, while total petrol sales for vehicles fell 2.1 percent.
